findings.title: IT spec text for F206.6.1, F204.6.5, F202.5.1, F201.5.2, F200.5.3 (and F200.2.x/F202.2.x) holds garbled PDF dumps of the assessment criteria
findings.rootCause: PDF parser in tools/gen_data.py appends trailing unit-level sections (criteria tables, guidance, synoptic tables) to the last topic leaf and mis-splits two-column 'To include' boxes.
findings.fix: Fix tools/gen_data.py's IT parser to stop each leaf at the 'Assessment criteria'/'Assessment guidance'/'Synoptic assessment' headings and at page-column breaks, and to join 'To include:' continuation lines into bullet rows; regenerate it.js (invariant 24) and add a smoke check that no IT spec string exceeds ~300 chars or starts with 'include:'.

findings.title: IT spec has a duplicate leaf: F206.6.1 'Ways to reflect' and 'Overview of the assessment' share a ref, so 'Ways to reflect' cannot be opened
findings.evidence: js/data/it.js:2246 and :2285 both 'ref': 'F206.6.1'; js/data/it.js:946-950; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/content-cs-it/it-f2061-spec-ipad.png (title 'Overview of the assessment', Notes 4 / Flashcards 14 are Ways to reflect's); eval on #cols: rows 'Ways to reflect F206.6.1' and 'Overview of the assessment F206.6.1', h1 after KOS.show('ref',{subject:'it',ref:'F206.6.1'}) = 'Overview of the assessment'
findings.rootCause: Generator does not filter non-topic headings and has no uniqueness check on refs.
findings.fix: In gen_data.py drop qualification-overview nodes ('Overview of the assessment', 'NEA Units') and assert ref uniqueness at generation; regenerate it.js; rename/prune any stored state keyed to F201.5.3 at the store gate like IT_NOT_TAKEN.

findings.title: Quiz answers are guessable: the correct option is A or B in 94% of CS questions (D only 12 of 1,347) and options are never shuffled
findings.evidence: node content-cs-it/quiz.js over dump.json: compsci [677,590,68,12], it [17,211,57,3]; longest-correct compsci 688/1347, it 201/288; js/engines/quiz.js:88 item.opts.forEach renders in authored order (shuffle at :25 is only applied to question order, :66)
findings.rootCause: Authoring habit (answer written first) plus an engine that never permutes options.
findings.fix: Shuffle each question's options at render with a deterministic per-question seed (map ans through the permutation; keep keyboard 1–4 on the displayed order) and rebalance the longest-option bias by trimming correct options or lengthening distractors in the authored banks; add a smoke check that no leaf has >50% of answers at one index after shuffling is off.

findings.title: 'Write it out' pill on worked examples overlaps the example's title on iPhone and iPad
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/content-cs-it/cs-4641-p3-iphone.png; eval at iphone: button rect x233 y824 w81 h23 position:absolute over title text; ipad hit 14/72, mac 1/72; css/views/ink.css:300 .k-n-writeout { position: absolute; inset-block-start: var(--sp-8); inset-inline-end: calc(var(--sp-8) * 9) }; js/core/content.js:373
findings.rootCause: Absolute positioning with a fixed inset instead of taking part in the header's layout.
findings.fix: Put the button in the worked card's head row as a flex item (title flex:1, min-width:0; actions group with Copy), wrapping under the title below 560px; give it the touch minimum height on coarse pointers.

findings.title: Same past-paper question appears twice in a CS leaf's Exam questions (worked card + bank item): 202 duplicate groups across 88 of 131 leaves
findings.evidence: node script over dump.json keyed on year-paper-question: 202 groups, 88 leaves, 1194 items; js/core/content.js:515 extend() concatenates exam without de-duplication; js/core/content.js:546 builds 'AQA June …' src vs bank files' 'AQA 2025 P1 Q1.1'
findings.rootCause: Bank files were authored independently of the worked cards; extend() concatenates blindly.
findings.fix: Drop the bank item when a worked card of the same leaf cites the same series/paper/question (do it in the bank files, or dedupe in extend() by a normalised src key), and normalise src labels to one format; add a smoke66 check for duplicate src within a leaf.

findings.title: Steps blocks in 4.5.x notes render prose as monospace code with literal **bold** and a redundant '1.' heading
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/content-cs-it/cs-4521-steps-literal-bold-mac.png; js/data/content/cs-p2-45a.js:104 { h: '1.', m: 'Divide by the base; record the **remainder**…' }; js/core/content.js:404 esc(st.m)
findings.rootCause: Authoring misuse of the steps schema (m is the monospace working line, n the inline note).
findings.fix: Move the prose to n (rendered through inline()) and drop the numeric h in those six leaves; optionally have validate_content.js flag markdown inside steps[].m and h matching /^\d+\.$/.

findings.title: ~30 CS flashcard decks ask the same fact twice ('Bandwidth?' + 'Define bandwidth.'), plus 11 cards duplicated across neighbouring leaves
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/content-cs-it/strict.txt (43 within-leaf pairs, confirmed by reading), /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/content-cs-it/cross.txt (11 cross-leaf pairs), /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/content-cs-it/dupes.txt (looser 800-line list); js/data/content/cs-p2-*.js flashcards arrays
findings.rootCause: Cards appended during the depth rewrite without de-duplicating against the original deck; no automated near-duplicate check.
findings.fix: Keep the fuller 'Define X.' card and delete the terse twin in each pair; when deleting, add the original position as the third element to every later card (invariant 87) so schedules do not shift. Pick one Boolean notation per deck. Add a smoke66 near-duplicate check (token Jaccard on the question ≥ 0.9 within a leaf).

findings.title: IT F201 (the unit still to sit) is much thinner than CS: no worked answers, 3 exam items and 5–6 quiz questions per leaf
findings.evidence: content-cs-it/metrics.txt (it F201.* rows: w0 fg0 ex3 q5-6); node scan: 15/150 IT exam q end with '[n]'; dump.json F201.2.3 spec ['□ Data mining','• Diagnostic Prescriptive □','□','□ Does','□']; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/content-cs-it/it-f2013-p1-ipadl.png (a 60-word note page, half the iPad landscape screen empty)
findings.rootCause: IT content was written to a lighter contract than smoke65/66 hold CS to; no IT depth smoke.
findings.fix: Add per F201 leaf: two worked exam answers (one 6-mark levels-of-response 'Discuss' with a band commentary), 6+ exam items across Describe/Explain/Discuss, 10 quiz questions, a scenario-based case per page; strip the '[n]' suffix from IT exam q text (marks already carry it).

findings.title: Derived exam items make the worked card's one-line 'Answer:' summary a tickable mark point, so full marks can be self-awarded with a real point missing
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/content-cs-it/exam-4621-q042-selfmark-mac.png; kos eval (exam2.js): allStepsNoAnswer 3, oneStepMissingButAnswer 3; js/core/content.js:568 (ms.push('**Answer:** '…)); js/engines/quiz.js:288 perMark, :294 fromTicks min(total,n); node count over dump.json: derivedWithAnswer 801, pointsGtMarks 729, pointsEqMarks 29
findings.rootCause: examFromWorked mixes the model answer into the mark-scheme array that the tally counts.
findings.fix: Render the Answer line as a non-tickable 'Model answer' row (e.g. ms item {answer:true} or a separate `answer` field on the item) and exclude it from points.length; re-check 4.7.3.5 Q07.1 which then has 3 points for 4 marks (see the mark-sum finding).

findings.title: Restoring an older backup folds a merged CS leaf's progress by dropping it: a completed member leaf loses to a weaker record on the kept leaf
findings.evidence: node audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/content-cs-it/alias2.js → replaceState-> {"compsci:4.5.1.1":{"conf":1,"checks":{"covered":true}}}, lastRef 4.4.1.5→4.4.1.3; js/core/store.js:371-374 (if (!hasOwnProperty(o, nk)) o[nk] = o[k]; delete o[k]); store.js:318-323 comment 'the kept leaf's wins'
findings.rootCause: A generic key rename with 'kept wins' semantics is applied to records that should be combined.
findings.fix: For the progress/notes/quiz maps, merge the member record into the kept one (max checks, max conf, best status, concatenated notes) instead of discarding it; keep 'kept wins' only for scalar fields that conflict. Add a smoke case with three members and a weak kept record.

findings.title: On iPhone a worked example keeps its 84px 'GIVEN / STEP n' label column, squeezing the working into 61% of the card
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/content-cs-it/recheck-writeout-4641-iphone.png (4.6.4.1, 'Trace Figure 5 and write G'); kos eval at iphone: card 370, label [34, 84], body [130, 226], gap 12; css/tokens.css:562 --wk-label-w: 84px; css/views/study.css:351 .k-n-wrow grid-template-columns: var(--wk-label-w) minmax(0,1fr) auto (no narrower tier)
findings.rootCause: The worked-row grid has no phone tier.

findings.title: Self-mark tally ignores a worked step's own mark weight ('[3 marks]'), so 60 derived CS exam items cannot reach full marks from their real mark points
findings.evidence: js/core/content.js:547-552 (ms line + ' [' + st.mk + ']'), js/engines/quiz.js:288-295 (perMark, fromTicks scaling); js/data/content/cs-p2-47b.js:355-375; node over content-cs-it/dump.json: derived items 801, realPoints<marks 60, weighted steps 34 (4.5.3.1, 4.5.4.5, 4.5.4.7, 4.5.5.3, 4.5.6.1 …)
findings.rootCause: Mark weights are stored as free text in st.mk and flattened into display text; the tally has no notion of a point's weight.
findings.fix: Carry the step weight as data (ms item {t, w}) and let fromTicks sum weights; author the missing final mark point where a worked card's steps add up to fewer marks than its src (e.g. 4.7.3.5 Q07.1 needs a 'whole loop correct' point); add a smoke check that step weights sum to the src marks.

findings.title: Back from a notes diagram (or any detour) reopens the topic's notes on page 1, losing the reading place
findings.evidence: kos eval content-cs-it/diagback.js at mac: {pg:2, h1:'#/sims/tl-list', back:'#/ref/compsci/4.2.1.1', tab:'Notes7', page:'0'}; js/modules/hub.js:2983 (cur = o.keep ? notePage : 0 — notePage is a closure variable that does not survive re-entering the view); js/core/content.js:450-453 (diagram click → KOS.sims.open)

findings.fix: Remember the note page per topic per device (state.ui.notePage['sid:ref'], like state.ui.lastProd) and reopen on it; or open the diagram's lab in a dialog/side pane over the notes (KOS.sims.embed already exists).

findings.title: IT desk's 'Start here' sends you to F200.1.1, a unit already sat and with no notes, instead of F201/F206
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/content-cs-it/it-f2015-3-nea-units-ipad.png ('START HERE F200.1.1' above 'F200 … Done · ≈51/60 Distinction'); js/modules/hub.js:2215-2224 continueCard (filters only by peekProgress status); content-cs-it/inv.json leavesNoContent lists every F200.* and F202.* leaf

findings.title: Bold containing an *italic* word renders literal ** in three IT F204 callouts

findings.title: Flashcards filed under the wrong leaf

findings.title: validate_content reports 9 errors in the CS merged leaves (cs-m-*) and 92 in IT: bare top-level paragraphs
findings.evidence: node tools/validate_content.js js/data/content/cs-*.js → '45 file(s) checked — 9 error(s), 190 warning(s)'; it-*.js → '92 error(s), 120 warning(s)'; js/data/content/cs-m-errors.js, cs-m-bit-patterns.js
findings.rootCause: The merged-leaf files were written after the validator pass, and the validator is not part of the smoke gate.
findings.fix: Wrap each flagged paragraph in the fitting callout (tip for exam technique, formula for file-size rules); for IT, turn the 'Characteristics/When used' lines into a kv or table block per technique; add validate_content to the smoke gate so it cannot regress.

findings.title: AQA mark-scheme shorthand (I., A., R., MAX, DPT) is used ~228 times with no explanation anywhere
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/content-cs-it/cs-4641-p3-iphone.png (step 3 note 'I. an incorrect gate for B·C.'); grep '"[IAR]\. ' js/data/content/cs-*.js bank-cs-*.js → 228; js/data/content/cs-p1-411a.js, cs-p1-42c.js, cs-p1-43b.js

findings.title: Functional-programming code is tagged 'text' (no Haskell label or highlighting) and assembly shows the raw label 'asm'
findings.evidence: dump scan of notes code blocks: 4.12.1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5/2.1/3.1 lang 'text', 4.7.3.5 lang 'asm'; js/core/content.js:70 LANG_NAME (no haskell/asm), :74 esc(LANG_NAME[lang] || lang)

findings.title: Six CS quizzes ask the identical question twice (same stem, same answer), e.g. 4.9.4.6 '172.32.0.5 is' as Q1 and Q2
findings.evidence: node over dump.json (exact lower-cased stem match): 7 pairs in 7 leaves, 6 with the same answer; js/data/content/cs-p2-49c.js:358-359 (two identical lines)
findings.rootCause: Copy-paste during authoring; no duplicate check in smoke65/66.
findings.fix: Replace the second item in each pair with a new question on another point of the leaf (4.9.4.6: a 10.x or 192.168.x address; 4.9.4.9: what a forwarded port maps to). Add an exact-duplicate check to the content lint.

findings.title: A third of quiz explanations say nothing: 502 of 1,635 'why' lines are under 16 characters ('Definition.' ×44, 'See the notes.' ×10, 'Spec.' ×6)
findings.evidence: node over dump.json: total 1635, why.length<16: 502; js/engines/quiz.js:123-125 (why rendered after '✕ Not quite · '); js/data/content/cs-p2-49c.js:358
findings.rootCause: Terse authoring of the older quiz layer; no minimum in the contract.
findings.fix: Rewrite short explanations as one sentence that says why the right option is right AND why the tempting wrong one is wrong; lint why.length >= 25 in the content gate.

findings.title: Search finds a CS/IT topic only by its spec wording or flashcards: words taught in the notes, quiz and exam questions return nothing
